name: proton-mail-bridge-client
description: Read, search, send, draft, and triage your Proton Mail inbox from Claude Desktop — entirely local via Proton Bridge, no third-party relay.
long_description:
Give Claude full access to your Proton Mail inbox: read, search, send, draft, triage threads, manage folders and labels, save attachments, and more — 95 tools in total.

Every step stays on your machine: Proton Bridge decrypts your mail locally and exposes it over local IMAP/SMTP, this server reads that local connection and builds a local SQLite search index, and Claude Desktop talks to it as a local stdio process. No email ever leaves your machine except through your own Proton account when you send.

Requires Proton Bridge to be installed, signed in, and running first — see proton.me/mail/bridge.

protonmail_username.title: Proton Mail address
protonmail_username.description: Your full Proton Mail email address

protonmail_password.title: Bridge password
protonmail_password.description: Proton Bridge's own password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password
